deploy.preDeployCommand: if [ "$PROCESS_TYPE" = "worker" ]; then echo "Skipping migrations for worker"; else php artisan migrate --force && php artisan db:seed --class=AdminUserSeeder --force && php artisan db:seed --class=BankAccountSeeder --force; fi
deploy.startCommand: if [ "$PROCESS_TYPE" = "worker" ]; then php artisan queue:work --sleep=3 --tries=3 --timeout=90; else php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080; fi
